column2: JUAN CARLOS LERENA and MARIA LERENA
column4: *** THE TWO THIS ARCHIVE EXISTS TO FIND, and the reason the red lane is drawn broken. *** They are named as the parents on Pablo Armando's army enrolment card and appear in NO OTHER RECORD ANYWHERE - not in Rosario, not in Montevideo, not in the full-text corpus. Every lane above is a candidate and none has been shown to hold them.

column2: The LERENA LARRIERA of San Jose
column4: *** TESTED AND EXCLUDED, 14 September 2026. *** Nine people, children of ALBERTO LERENA and MARIA INES LARRIERA. Zelmira Carlota was followed to her marriage in 1901 and her death in 1945, and the row says plainly: "she is NOT ours". *** A worked negative is worth as much as a lane. ***

column2: The LARENA of Cayasta and Gualeguaychu
column4: Nineteen people under the A-spelling, in the two Argentine provinces either side of the Parana. *** THE SPELLING IS NOT THE PROBLEM - this archive has catalogued LERENA read as SERENA, LORENA, LESINA and six more. *** What is missing is any document joining them to a Uruguayan house.

Married ADELA CAMIGLIA; a son AVELINO CARLOS born 1904. *** The forename AVELINO is the one that runs through Sancho's house ***, which is suggestive and is not evidence. Worked in September and not joined.

column2: The LERENA of Trinidad with no father named
column4: CAYETANA FAUSTINA, whose son Luis was registered in 1895 with no father on the act; RODOLFO BERNARDO and ISMAEL, each a father who appears once. *** Real people on real acts, attached to nobody. ***
Four people - Anna, Annunziata, Laurensa, Savina, Domenico, Paolo. *** An Italian name that is not a spelling of this one ***, kept in the register so that nobody has to discover them twice.

Felipa, Pedro and Isidoro Lerena in the parish marriages of Chuquibamba, Condesuyos. *** Found while searching the full-text corpus and recorded because a rare name in a far place is exactly what a careless session would merge. ***
One full-text hit in the Colombian Catholic records. *** Not pursued and not ours. ***
